evidence.reason: The live queue compatibility recheck at line 1885 is sequenced before runner_units_stopped and drain_check. A runner can write incompatible queue state after that recheck and exit before the stopped-unit/drain checks, allowing both checks to pass and the rollback to proceed against a queue the prior target cannot read. Moving the live compatibility recheck after the stop and drain checks closes that window; this is an ordinary correctness repair, not a new requirement.
